findings.expected: Serve a French banner image (e.g. banner-fr.png) with the text "Un financement adapté à vos projets. Des taux concurrentiels. Des conditions claires. Aucune surprise."
findings.description: French page uses the English banner image containing English text ("Financing that fits your plans...").
Footer is left in English on French pages.
Uses informal "tu" while the rest of the site (e.g. hero title "vous ressemble") uses "vous".
"Appliquer pour" is an anglicism (calque of "apply for").
Empty full-name validation message is in English on the French form; other fields show "Ce champ est obligatoire."
Label uses "e-mail" while the error message uses "courriel" (the Quebec standard); inconsistent terminology.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 12 500,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: Raw template variable {montant} shown instead of the amount in the confirmation message.
Section heading left in English on the French dashboard.
Transaction dates use US MM/DD/YYYY format in French (ambiguous, not fr-CA); English and fr-CA convention use ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
In French, zero takes the singular; "0 prêts actifs" is plural.
"Balance" is an anglicism for an account balance; French uses "solde".
"Statement" (bank statement) mistranslated as "déclaration" (declaration/tax return).
"Estimer un nouveau prêt" link on the French dashboard points to the English calculator page.
Meaning reversed: "Pay later" translated as "Pay now", contradicting the help text "Premier paiement reporté de 30 jours".
Monthly payment uses English currency format; fr-CA requires decimal comma and trailing $ (as in other French pages).

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: French drops the condition "subject to credit approval".

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais en cas de remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Charges" (fees) translated as "accusation" (criminal accusation), wrong word in context.
"Close" button of the modal translated as the adjective "Proche" (near) instead of the verb "Fermer".

findings.expected: Use a French promo image showing "Taux variable : 5,2 %"
findings.description: French promo image states a fixed rate of 4.9%, contradicting the alt text, the page rate (5,2 %, variable) and the English image.
